events.dataContent:
United States U19 vs Germany U19: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a prestigious friendly match where the United States U19 national team takes on one of Europe's strongest sides, the Germany U19 national team. This contest, held at a neutral venue in Spain as part of a training camp, will be an excellent test for both teams ahead of their official qualifying tournaments.

Kick-off: November 12, 2025, 16:30 UTC (19:30 MSK) Stadium: Marbella Football Center, Marbella, Spain Competition: International Friendly

USA U19 vs Germany U19: Match Preview

This match is a classic showdown between two leading football schools at the youth level. The American team, which relies on athleticism and speed, will test its strength against a tactically disciplined and technically gifted German side. For the coaches of both teams, the result is secondary to the opportunity to test their reserve players and tactical schemes ahead of the European and World Championship qualifiers.

Team Form and Analysis

United States U19

The 'Stars and Stripes' have brought a squad to Spain composed of the best talents from MLS academies and young players already competing in Europe. The Americans are traditionally strong in their physical conditioning and discipline. The team will focus on high pressing and quick transitions from defense to attack. This match will be a crucial stage of their preparation for the CONCACAF U-20 Championship qualification.

Germany U19

The German 'Bundes-team' U19 is always a collection of talents from the academies of Bayern Munich, Borussia Dortmund, RB Leipzig, and other top clubs. The team emphasizes ball control, combination play, and high individual skill. For the German national team, this training camp is a key phase in their preparation for the elite round of the UEFA U-19 Championship qualifiers.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • USA U19 (4-3-3): Sargis; Wiley, Che, Neal, Gomez; Paredes, Wolff, Luna; Saliba, N'GJaay, Santana.
  • Germany U19 (4-2-3-1): Urbig; Wagner, Buchmann, Collins, Rothe; Ulrich, Diehl; Bischof, Wenig, Ibrahimović; Theuerkauf.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Friendly matches are always unpredictable, but the German school of football at the youth level is traditionally considered one of the strongest in the world. The Americans will put up a fight with their physical power, but the technical superiority will likely be on the side of the European team.

  • Main Prediction: Germany to Win or Draw (X2). The German team looks like the favorite on paper and should at least avoid defeat. A draw is also a very likely outcome in a friendly match.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. This is a meeting of two strong youth national teams that will be testing their attacking setups. An exchange of goals is a common occurrence in such matches.

Russia vs Peru: Watch Live Stream Online - Friendly Match 12.11.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a friendly match where the Russian national team will host one of the solid mid-tier teams of South American football, the Peru national team. This encounter will be an important stage of preparation for the Russian team and an opportunity to test their strength against a strong and resilient opponent.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 12, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Russian national team, under the guidance of Valery Karpin, continues its series of friendly matches. The team is in good form, having secured a number of victories in recent games. The coaching staff is actively scouting new players and testing tactical schemes. The match against a representative from the South American continent is an excellent opportunity to gain valuable experience playing against a team with a different style.

The Peru national team is a participant in the South American World Cup qualifiers. The 'Incas' are known for their fighting spirit, tactical discipline, and technical players. For the Peruvian team, the match in Russia will also be an important element of preparation for their official games. The Peru national team will be looking to showcase their best football and achieve a positive result.

Head-to-Head History

In recent history, the national teams of Russia and Peru have not met. This will be their first head-to-head encounter, which adds special interest and unpredictability to the match.

Russia vs Peru Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider the Russian national team a slight favorite due to the home-field advantage. However, the Peru national team is a very experienced and strong opponent capable of putting up a fight. a tense match with a lot of tactical struggle is expected.

  • Likely Outcome: Russia will not lose. On their home turf, the Russian team should at least avoid defeat against a strong South American opponent.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the friendly status of the match and the fact that South American teams often play defensively away from home, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' seems logical.
  • Key Factor: The home-field advantage for Russia versus the tactical training and experience of the Peru national team.

Tune into the Russia vs Peru live stream on tutsport.net and follow this interesting international showdown!
